verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's Agents SDK provides persistent, stateful agent environments on Durable Objects with their own state, storage and lifecycle, plus hibernate/wake. The Think harness automatically persists messages in Durable Object SQLite and offers workspace and bash tools, and Workflows persist state across retried steps. However, nothing documents automatic checkpointing of a coding agent's working environment (filesystem or sandbox snapshots) while it works. Missing for 10: explicit automatic checkpoint/snapshot of the agent's workspace or sandbox state, restore-from-checkpoint docs, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can give my coding agent a persistent runtime environment that checkpoints its state automatically while working

citations.quote: Agents are persistent, stateful execution environments for agentic workloads, powered by Cloudflare Durable Objects.
message persistence, streaming, client tools, stream resumption, and extensions — all backed by Durable Object SQLite
automatically retry failed tasks, and persist state for minutes, hours, or even weeks
